about_the_game:
During players' interstellar adventure, they encounter the "Navigators" and build a customized spaceship to traverse alien battlefields and clash fiercely with hostile vessels of diverse styles. As the cosmic cataclysm dubbed 'The Great Flood' engulfs the galaxy, they need to unearth the truth behind the crisis, overcome labyrinthine challenges, and arrive at a safe galaxy for survival.

The game features dual joystick controls, a top-down bullet-hell shooter gameplay, and roguelike loot-hunting gameplay. Hundreds of buffs, weapons, and special skills are freely available for combination. It supports four-player multiplayer mode. By cultivating different characters called "Navigator", players improve their skills and unlock dozens of Live2D animated characters and interactive plots.

Weapon Collection & Ship Enhancement

Kinds of powerful weapons will drop randomly in the fight. Pick them up and arm your spaceship instantly. Diverse random weapons such as Machine Guns, Spore Cannon, Flash Cannon, etc., provide each fight with different strategic possibilities. When you enjoy the battle with thrilling surprises, please make your choices and tear up all the enemies.

Break Through the Blockade: Reach the Safe Zone

When 'The Great Flood' catastrophe sweeps across the cosmos, you will take command of a starship and join forces with your navigator to fend off relentless attacks from unknown races. Explore vast resources and upgrade your vessel in procedurally generated star map stages, fighting to break free amidst the perilous cosmic battlefield. Each breakthrough brings you closer to your ultimate goal; the dawn of the Safe Zone awaits your collective arrival.

Navigator Growth: Build Relationships and Fight Together

Hailing from high-dimensional civilizations, these navigators boast distinct personalities and offer three unique growth paths. With their growth, you will fight with the navigators in the battles to overcome dilemmas and build romantic relationships with them together.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: win10/win11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700 or AMD FX 8320
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 or AMD Radeon R9 280
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: win10/win11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

short_description: The Navigator Project is a twin-stick rogue-like Shoot'em-up game with interactive elements of raising cute waifus. Grab weapons, collect enhancements, upgrade your ship, and blast everything to pieces! Raise your very own cute navigator and cruise through the stars together!
supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean
